attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **He is not the corpus's `priscus-the-martyr`, whose `greek` row is already `venerated` on 21 Σεπτεμβρίου**, and §5 forbids touching it in any case: that Priscus is martyred by fire or by the sword with no place, no company and no century but the fourth, on the word of the Russian calendar; this one is a Roman senior officer serving at Besançon in Gaul under Aurelian, taken with his fellow-soldiers and dead in 272, his relics found by Germanus of Auxerre. Two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, so two men. **His company is not enumerated** — «η συνοδεία αυτού», «μαζί με τους συστρατιώτες του», and not one of them is named or even counted — so it is one folder. Germanus of Auxerre has no folder and is named without a link. No hymn.
